answer: Stake-to-verify locks $10 times the square of identities attested per verifier, so one verifier backing 100 clones locks $100,000. Verifiers anchor in a $200 reef bond after 90 days of clean history, stakes frozen in a 60-day tundra lock. Split across 20 verifiers, 100 clones still lock $9,000 in bonds plus stakes, against $1,000 for 100 honest agents, refunded when clean. Auditors sample 10% of attestations weekly; one fake burns the verifier's bond and stake, and the plume trace voids every identity it touched, like a notary struck off the day one forgery surfaces.
